findings.location: math_gauge/review.py::compare_models, Lean failure resolution and human_comparison_eligible assignment (approximately lines 413–446 at review time)

findings.recommendation: For the future contract revision, require decision != unresolved in human comparison eligibility; retain decisive Lean failure as a separate strict-completion failure if desired.
findings.current_impact: None in this run: all questions remain human pending and the checked applied reviews are AI; human_comparison_eligible is false.
findings.disposition: Parent acknowledged; defer contract change until after the freeze. Do not mutate frozen comparison code during the current run.
